notes: Technical report on hybrid Mamba-Transformer architecture, pre-training, MiniPuzzle compression, VLMs, and reasoning post-training. No dedicated safety evaluation section with scores. Safety appears only as training (AEGIS2.0 preference data; Stage 2 'safety alignment' SFT mix; VL data sanitization) and one qualitative note that the 8B model struggled on unnamed internal safety benchmarks. Table 10 is labeled 'alignment benchmarks' but reports MT-Bench, MMLU, MBPP+, MATH, IFEval, BFCL—capability/instruction-following, not safety; skipped under pilot safety-only evalResults. All general capability tables (Tables 4–9, 11–12, vision Tables 7–8) skipped. No external safety testers or risk-framework decisions.
